title: Italian Air Force chief introduces Malmgren's book

tellings.quote: one of the people introducing the book was the chief of the Italian air force

plain: In Italy in 2025, the chief of the Italian Air Force was one of the people who introduced a book by Harald Malmgren, a former presidential adviser who says he handled UFO material. Malmgren tells Michels this himself, without naming the book. It would mean a top military officer stood publicly beside his work.
